Folio check_instances requires every instance property, VARIANT included, to have a property definition, so Folio-valid sets define a VARIANT property named like the variant group (default = the default variant's value)

Effective sizing of a node = its StudioChildLayout sizing, else the sizing implied by its own container modes (AUTO hug, FIXED fixed), else FIXED; missing child fields default INHERIT / grow 0 / AUTO; the root of a solve has no flow parent so FILL on a root comes only from a child record and is refused (fill_on_root)

Any armed (non-null) trigger of the 17 StudioTrigger types counts for reachability; only NODE/BACK/CLOSE end the action array (STU-PRO-104); a reaction on a page spread is a node of the document (no owning frame, no edge)
FlowWarning.reaction_index is the index in the flow's reaction order = design entries in record order, each node's reactions in stored order; the warning also carries node_id

An override value may be a VARIABLE_ALIAS, and an instance property / property default may be an alias or carry bound_variable_id: all resolve through resolve_variable and their chains join the read footprint; bound_variable_id and an alias value naming different variables are AmbiguousSource(instance, property/<name>)
